name: llm-qwen3.5-4b
description: Qwen3.5-4B (text model) read at the answer token, with SemIf's JSON prompt layout (github.com/TheoLeeCJ/SemIf). Zero-shot, no fine-tuning by this project.
summary: The most accurate model here: 80.5% on JevBench's public items, 6 points behind hosted Jev.
use_when: Accuracy matters most: policy checks, multi-step judgments, long documents.
You ask several questions about the same text: the text is read once and shared across them.
You have about 9 GB of free memory.
avoid_when: You need answers in well under a second on a Mac: it takes about 0.65 s per request here, and several seconds for very long documents.
Memory is tight: use llm-qwen3.5-2b or nli-deberta-large.

calibration.note: Fitted with training/calibrate.py on held-back rows of data/calib.jsonl (public gold-labelled tasks): choice and yes/no minimise negative log-likelihood, score minimises the error of the expected level.
